notes.subject: nĩ / ũrĩa
notes.rationale: Kĩhibirania kĩtarĩ na kiyuko kĩa 'nĩ' na 'ũrĩa'; Gĩkũyũ gĩkĩhĩtũkĩte

notes.subject: שפתים ישק
notes.rationale: Kĩng'Era kĩa mbere kĩa 'matukũ' kĩgĩtũmwo megithũkĩ nĩguo kĩehereria kĩndũ kĩacio — kĩaho kĩayeha gĩtarĩkia

notes.subject: משיב דברים נכחים
notes.rationale: Andũ aingĩ a taũri mehĩtia: kuma kuuma 'ũrĩa oigĩte' gĩkĩrũmwo kinya 'ũrĩa woigĩte mciario' — KJV, JPS metĩkĩtie 'kũheana mciario mwega'

translation: Matukũ nĩmakwaranĩririo nĩ ⟨ũrĩa⟩ oigĩte mciario ma ndũhĩro.
